title: Albino Red and Bob Koester
summary: Slim remembers running with Albino Red in 1928-29 and the record man on Grand Avenue who owed him money from the 1964 overseas trip.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Did you ever hear the name Albino Red?

I run around with him, still in Missouri, Arkansas, Memphis, me and him running down the road. Albino Red, yeah, he can work with it. Albino Red ought to be about 74 years old right now tomorrow. 74? Yeah, he ought to be.
He's about 74, 75.

I know him well. I know him like I did P. R. Gibson and Stuckey. And Vannels, you know. Yeah. Albino Red was playing with Ralph Hudson. He come to Crothersville, come to Steele, come to Hollins. And we still would meet again down in Memphis. He was another man with the left. He's the, with the dirty dozen there, Albino Red. He was, he would catch that day so fast, running.
Where was he from, do you know? That I couldn't tell.
Bob Casper could tell you about where he was from. He ought to have, because he was recording for Bob. But I knowed him in 1928 and 29. Yeah. Yeah, Albino, he's down in St. Louis now.
He's dead?
In St. Louis. He's living in St. Louis. He worked for Bob when he was recording.
What Bob?
Bob Casper. You know Bob? I've written to him.
I would like to meet him. He's on Grand Avenue.
Yeah, he's on 7 Grand Avenue. I know, 7 Grand Avenue. I have a map, I will find him. Hey, he's there all the time. Yeah.
Vester, you gonna catch him? You gonna catch him?
You gonna catch him? I know, I'm gonna catch him myself.
I recorded for him. A week ago, I'm gonna catch it myself. I recorded also, played all the time with him. Make sure when you catch him, you know. Yeah.
Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I'm going to catch it myself tomorrow. I recorded for it a week ago. I'm going to catch it myself tomorrow. I recorded it also. I played organ with it.
Make sure when you catch him, you know. Yeah.
Because he's very hard to catch like that. I know him well. We went overseas in 64, he owed me 65 dollars.
Yeah, well, and Steiner too. He's another one that's very hard to catch when it comes time to pay up. Yeah, you can't call him. They like all the good stuff, but they don't like to pay for it.
